WITH customer_totals AS (
  SELECT c.CustomerId, COALESCE(SUM(i.Total), 0) AS total_spent
  FROM Customer c
  LEFT JOIN Invoice i ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId
  GROUP BY c.CustomerId
),
shares AS (
  SELECT CustomerId, total_spent,
         total_spent / SUM(total_spent) OVER () AS share
  FROM customer_totals
),
above_average AS (
  SELECT total_spent, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share
  FROM shares
)
SELECT AVG(total_spent) AS average_total_spent,
       AVG(share) AS average_share,
       AVG(share - average_share) AS average_share_difference
FROM above_average
WHERE share > average_share
